::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** July 22 [after 1863]  
**From:** Elderfield  
**Manuscript:** MS British Library Add 45224 L
:::

Dear Madam
The scene of the [Heir of Redclyffe](cmy_books/cmybook_15.qmd) is imaginary but I had Clovelly in my mind when describing the bay

yours truly
C M Yonge
